name: Ijichi Rinana
source:
Daughter of Katsutoshi. A black gal who is active and energetic, just like her father.

She is very interested in sex, but the men who approach her are all players who are similar to her father, which is frustrating for her. (As a result, she is still a virgin).

She likes Masashi's reserved and intellectual appearance, and actively tries to get his attention.

"Hi there☆ I'm Ijichi Rinana, Papa's daughter♪ Nice to meet you☆ Kyahahaha"

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt279/apt279.html#link_character]official site[/url]]
